tei:div.tei:p: 177) bskal pa shing bya lo pa'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i dgung thun skabs su thun chung zhig gi snang ba la thig le sngon po shar ba'i klong du: yul yangs pa can yid du 'ong ba me tog sna tshogs dang bya rigs mi 'dra ba mang pos gu ru ha ri ni sa'i sgra di ri ri sgrogs nas thams cad dga' ba'i nyams can sha stag gnas pa dang: de'i dbus su 'ja' 'od kyi dgur khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du bdag gi bla ma padma las 'brel rtsal dngaḥ bdud 'joms rdo rje: ngo mi shes pa'i bla ma grub thob mang po dang: mkha' 'gro bde ba'i go cha dang: ral gri 'bar ma: gsal byed dbang mo rnams kyi gtsos mkha' 'gro mang po dang: gzhan yang dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas bdud rtsi sman sgrub mdzad kyin 'dug pas: bdag der lhags nas yid bzhin nor bu'i phyag la 'jus nas shin tu gdung sems drag pos smre sngags bton pas dpa' bo chen pos zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas thugs brtse ba chen pos 'di skad gsungs: e ma rigs ldan brtse ba'i grogs: thugs ngal 178)ma mdzad thugs rgya glod: nged cag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i grong: gzhan na med do rang snang nyid: chos nyid gcig gi cho 'phrul las: tha dad med do rigs ldan ma: tshogs kyi gral du bzhugs dang sproḥ gsungs nas thugs brtse brtse mdzad nas chang ka pā la gang gnang nas skus gar bsgyur te: he ru ka rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras pa: phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnol thabs su 'dzin cing spyan bar snang la ha re gzigs nas 'di skad gsungs: hūm̐ hrīḥ mi 'gyur mi shigs rdo rje'i sku: dwangs gsal 'od kyi phung por ldan: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: 'gyur med sku yi dbang thob shog: dharma kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐ hrīḥ brjod bral sngags kyi rang gdangs gsung: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: bdag gi gsung dang gnyis med pa'i:

gsung gsang mi bzad dbang thob shog: dharma wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag rang byung chos kyi sku: gnyis med thugs gsang 'khor lo'i dbang: rig pa'i bu la bskur ba yis: bdag gi thugs dang gnyis med pa'i: bskur thob bral ba'i dbang thob shog: dharma tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: a 179)a ā: zhes gsungs ma thag tu bdag tha mal gyi rtog pa glo bur du 'gags nas sngar gyi bag chags 'ga' sad nas: skad cig gis rdo rje phag mo'i skur lam gyis gsal nas yab kyi skur 'khril nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rig sku mngon du gyur nas yab yum gnyis med kyi dgongs pa yun gcig skabs: 'khor gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig tu 'di skad gsungs: a haṃ siddhi su kha st+wam̐: a la la ho ngo mtshar che: gsang sngags bdag po he ru ka: ye shes sku brnyes rdo rje 'chang: ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos: dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'byung gnas che: dpa' bo yab yum gsang chen mdzod: dngos grub 'byung gnas khyod la bstod: gsang sngags lam mchog bla na med: rgyal kun thugs gsang nye lam mchog: mngon gyur gding thob rig sku brnyes: rdo rje dbang nyid la bstod: lha las lhag gyur zung 'jug sku: sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor kun gyi rje: sku dang ye shes dbyings su zlum: mngon rdzogs rgyal po khyod la bstod: ces gsungs nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bshams nas dkyil 'khor 180)gtso bo bdud 'joms he ru ka yab yum 'od kyi rnam par gyur te dpa' bo nyid la thim ma thag tu skus gar bsgyur nas he ru ka cad te'u bhan thod 'dzin pa rnal 'byor rol pa'i cha byad can du gyur nas: a haṃ: yab yum reg pa 'phrad pa sku rdo rje: snang stong dbyer med bum dbang ngo bor rdzogs: byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs gsung rdo rje: gsal stong dbyer med gsang dbang ngo bor rdzogs:

dkar dmar thig le zhal mjal thugs rdo rje: bde stong dbyer med sher dbang ngo bor rdzogs: lhan skyes ye rig ye shes rdo rjair smin: rig stong dbyer med tshig dbang ngo bor rdzogs: bskur thob bral ba don dam gsang ba'i dbang: rigs ldan ḍā ki khyod la bskur ba yis: rags pa lus dang phra ba rtsa khams dag: rags pa ngag dang phra ba rlung khams smin: rags pa sems dang phra ba thig le rdzogs: sgo gsum bag chags rtog sgrib kun bral nas: rnam smin tshe dbang phyag chen lhun grub kyi: go 'phang mngon gyur don gyi dbang thob shog: ces gsungs nas spyan hrig ger bdag la gzigs nas cung zad dgongs pa gtad pa'i mthar: 'di ni thabs shes snying po don dam pa gsang ba'i 181)dbang bzhi pa bskur ba yin pas gzhan la ma bstan cig: dus la babs tshe 'o cag gnyis 'dzom 'ong: de'i bar du snang ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i thabs mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i yab dang 'grogs shig gsungs: de nas rdo rje karma mkha' 'gro zhi ba mtshos dkyil 'khor gyi shar nas tshogs kyi drang ba thogs nas dbyangs snyan gdangs kyis: a hoḥ skye med rang byung don dam chos sku yi zhing na: gzugs snang dag pa rab 'byams thabs shes kyi dkyil 'khor: zag med bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsi la rol nas: bde stong dag pa rab 'byams dngos grub kyang zhu'o: rtsal snang dag pa rab 'byams dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro: 'dod don dag pa rab 'byams bdud rtsi la= zhen bral dag pa rab 'byams dngos= snod bcud dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa: rang byung dag par rab 'byams bdud= snang rtog dag pa rab 'byams dngos= rang snang dag pa 'og min nyams dga' yi gnas na: mched lcam dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje yi spun grogs: thabs shes myang grol bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod la rol nas: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams dngos grub de zhu'o: ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres nas:

182)'ja' lus chos sku 'grub pa'i gdams pa rang zhu'o: zhes gsungs nas thams cad kyis rang rang gi rigs dang gzungs ma rnams kyis kyang glu gar mdzad nas tshogs kyi dga' ston la rol: de nas bdag gis bsam pa la 'di rnams yid bzhin nor bu'i sku'i bkod pa yin par 'dra: da dung zhing khams su zhig gzhan du e yod: bdag kyang phyir mi 'gro zhing 'dir lhag dgos bsam pas: nyid kyi zhal nas: e ma gson dang rigs ldan ma: zhing dang gzhal yas lha'i rnam rol: chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi rtsal: rang byung ye shes de ka'o: logs na med do shes par mdzod: ces gsungs nas sku gcig gis bkod pa lnga mdzad nas dbus su rdo rje he ru ka yab yum: shar du buddha he ru ka yab yum: lho ru ratna he ru ka yab yum: nub tu padma he ru ka: byang du las kyi he ru ka rnams rang rang gi yum dang sras 'khor thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi rol pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa du mar spros nas bzhugs pa la: bdag gis shin tu dad mos drag pos phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad zhus: skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du: rig 'dzin bla ma khyed dang mi 'bral zhing: rim pa gnyis kyi lam mchog mthar phyin nas: bde stong phyag 183)rgya chen po'i sa thob shog: thabs shes zung 'jug ting 'dzin la brten nas: 'di nas 'jig rten 'og tu bdag nyid kyang: mkha' 'gro mi yi gzugs can nye rgyu'i grogs: dpa' bo khyed kyi dgyes pa bskyed pa'i yum: bdag gyur smon lam mthu yis 'phrad par shog: 'phrad nas bar chad rkyen dbang mi 'gro zhing: sku tshe mthar phyin bstan 'gro'i don bsgrubs nas: rgyal ba'i mdzad pa yongs su 'grub par shog: gsang gter lde mig rtsa ba'i chos bdag dang: las ldan bu slob skyes bu la sogs pa: lhan 'dzoms bar chad 'gal zla med pa ru: bden gnyis bslu med nus pas 'grub par shog: bdag la bzang ngan 'brel bcas 'gro ba kun:

dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar: rig 'dzin bla ma khyed dang mi 'bral zhing: zab gter rgya mtsho'i dpal la longs spyod nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zhes gsol ba btab pa'i mthar a a āḥ gsungs nas bkod pa rnams gcig tu bsdus te: lha nyid rang la rang nyid lha: thams cad ye shes gcig gi 'phrul: nga yi bkod pa brjod las 'das: snang rtog lha yi phyag rgyar 184)rdzogs: sgra grags bde chen rdo rje'i gsung: dran rtog chos nyid de bzhin nyid: gnyis med thugs kyi thig ler chub: tha dad med do rigs kyi bu: zhes gsungs nas shog dril gcig gnang ste: de gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i chos skor red: dus babs rten 'brel ldan na brda khrol shin tu zab 'ong gsungs ma thag mkha' 'gro gnyis kyis bdag gi lag pa g.yas g.yon du 'jus nas 'di skad zer: e ma rigs ldan ḍā ki lha yi lcam: khyod thugs sun skyo ngal che ba yis: zhing 'dir byon na ngas grogs byed: nged cag mched lcam dam tshig ldan: zab bcud gdams pa 'di na lhag: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa yod: dam nyams grib kyi skyon dang bral: dpa' bo dang ni mkha' 'gro yi: grogs bzang zhing 'dir lhag par yod: 'o cag mched lcam dam re gtsang: nyes pa'i skyon gyis gos pa med: gnas 'dir yon tan bsam mi khyab: 'gro don bstan pa zhing du lhag: 'di ru bzhugs na don gnyis po: ma 'bad rang byung 'grub pa legs: 'jig rten mi sems bdud kyis bsgyur: chos bzhin bsgrub pa nyin skar tsam: bla slob dam tshig sdom mi bsrung: bde skyid la kha'i na bun 'dra: 'gro don 'ong ba 185)lta zhog dang: rang gzhan nyams pa'i skyon gyis gos: de sogs 'phral rkyen du ma yis: skyo sun thugs ngal rgyun chad med: de'i phyir da ni zhing du byon: zhes zer: bdag gi bsam pa dga' ya ler song nas da phyir mi 'gro bar dpa' bo nyid kyi drung du 'dug dgos snyam yang lan ci yang ma smras par yud cig gnas pas:

yang nga rang gi grogs mched dang grogs su gyur pa 'gas mgrin gcig tu 'di skad zer: kyai: ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro dgongs: bdag cag rnams kyi skyabs gcig pu: gter chen bla ma zhing du 'dren: mi re'i khog nas snying re phyungs: mgon med bdag cag shul du bor: chos dang gdams pa zhu sa med: da res mkha' 'gro zhing du 'dren: nged cag rnams kyis ji ltar byed: zab pa'i dam chos su la zhu: zab gter 'dzin skyong su yis byed: skyabs dang re sa su la 'cha': zhing du byon pa'i 'os med pas: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzhugs gsol zhu: zhes brjod pa dang: yang mkha' 'gro gnyis kyis: gson dang rdo rje'i mched po rnams: khyed rnams dam tshig ldan pa yis: da res zhing 'dir lhan du 'tshogs: smon lam ldan pas spro ba bskyed: 186)da lan khyed rnams zhu ba bzhin: gcig gam gnyis gsum bzhi 'phrul yig: de phan zhing 'dir dus babs yin: mkha' 'gro'i bka' la 'da' ba med: zer nas dpa' bo chen po'i phyag g.yas g.yon la thim: de nas rim bzhin yongs rdzogs sku la thim nas grogs mkha' 'gro gnyis dang dpa' bo nyid rang dang bcas yud tsam bzhugs par bdag gis phyag phul nas 'di skad zhus: kye ma kyi hud 'gro 'dul thugs rje can: mgon med nyam thag bdag la brtse bas zungs: bdag ni 'jig rten yul du ci phyir 'gro: skyabs dang re sa mgon dang dpung gnyen med: dus dang rten 'brel bdud dbang rkyen khar 'chor: rang 'dris ma gtogs kun gyis brnyas dmod byed: dam gtsang bu slob rnams la skur pa 'debs: gter gnyis 'gro don 'ong ba phar la zhog: kun gyis log lta'i gzhi ru gyur pa las: 'dzin skyong spel ba'i nus pa bdag la med: snying gi dwangs ma rje khyed zhing du byon: snying rje'i yul gyur bdag 'dras ji ltar byed: man ngag zab pa'i gdams pa zhu sa med: kho mo'i snying gtam nyams len su la zhu:

sdug bsngal mi bzod srog la thug pa byung: da ni cis kyang 187)'gro mi dgos par zhus: 'jig rten yul du bdag 'dra'i 'gro don dka': zab gter rten 'brel sna kha bdud kyis bsgyur: grogs dang chos bdag gzhan rkyen kho nar song: gal te rten 'brel dbang gis grogs 'phrad kyang: dpa' bo khyed 'dra lta bu lta zhog dang: thig le dbab 'dren don ldan go bar dka': thabs shes zung 'jug rig sku lta zhog dang: lan chags bu brgyud sa bon rgyun chad med: myur lam zab mo'i dgos don phar zhog dang: gzugs byad tsam la chags shing 'khor bar skye: dag smin rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu phar zhog dang: nyin mtshan bar med chags sems rgyun chad med: snang stong dbyer med snying po phar zhog dang: lo shas zla shas tsam gyis gnyis phung 'grub: de 'drar bsam na bdag 'dras 'gro don dka': gu ru padma'i smon lam mthu btsan pas: bco lnga nas bzung rang yul rgyab tu bor: dpa' bo khyod nyid rigs kyi bdag por khur: rtsa brgyad dus su nyid kyis rjes su bzung: rim pa gnyis kyi lam mchog mthar phyin mdzad: khyad par nang don ye shes mngon sum du: sad cing zab gter chos sgo du ma 'byed: 188)gter gnyis bstan pa mthar rgyas 'gro ba'i don: rgya chen yong ba'i smon lam 'phro ldan kyang: dus dbang smon log bdud kyi dbang du song: da ni bsam zhing bsam na skyo ba skyes: 'gro don mi 'ong 'khor ba'i bsnon pa byed: grogs kyang mi bsam khyed 'dra shin tu dkon: dpa' bo khyed kyis myur tu rjes bzung nas: sngon gyi rjes brtse yal bar ma dor bar: bde skyong dbang mo thugs rjes bzung du gsol: 'jig rten khams su mi 'gro bka' gnang zhu: zhes phyag la 'jus nas drag tu dus shing zhus pas thugs brtse mdzad nas 'di skad gsungs: e ma rigs ldan brtse ba'i grogs: thugs sun skyo ngal ma mdzad ang: nga 'gro dang 'ong med chos sku'i ngang:

dus nam yang 'du 'bral ga la yod: klong rig dbyings 'od gsal ngang skyongs dang: nga chos byings mkha' klong yangs par shar: da dbyings kyi rol par dbyings la bzhugs: gsungs nas gtso 'khor gsum po 'od thig gi rnam par gyur nas rang gi snying gar thim par snang: sa ma ya: ha ha/ gang gi slob 'bangs kun gyi tha shal ba// mdo med chos med bde skyong dbang mo yis// 'khrul snang zad med nyin mtshan bar med pas// 'khrul 189)tshig yig ris bris pa dgos med kyang*// shī la badzra nan chags chos bskul ngor// mdo med 'chol mos 'khrul snang yig ris bris// rang la dad mos yod pa'i bu slob mchog /shī la badzra la sogs mched grogs rnams// thugs kyi bzhed don cung zhig phul ba dge dge'o// ༈ ( Dakini Secret letter here) dbyings mi 'gyur thig le'i mkha' klong nas: gdangs rang byung 'phrul gyi brda don ngoms: shar rta bdun dkyil 'khor lho ru 'phen: phag nag po'i 'khun pas yul gsum 'jigs: dbyar rnga yi rang nor gtsug tu mdzes: srin bya yi mdangs ltar 'gran la chas: byang mun pa'i khrod nas glog dmar 'phyo: gnyis skyes kyi mdangs dang ma bral gal: brag spre'us yal ka'i ri dwags la: mdog dmar ser rdzas kyis bslu brid ngoms: gdong lnga yi rang tshugs ma zin na: lha dmar pos rgol ba rang la sdang: gnas chu gnyis 'dus pa'i g.yas zur na: bya thang dkar 'gying 'dra'i g.yon ngos su: chos pusti brtsegs pa'i lte ba ru: dpal 190)rta mgrin lha dgu'i zab sgrub ni: gnam lcags kyi sgrom dang rdor phur yod: dus ri mo can gyi mjug tu gsal: dpa' bo ( Dakini Secret letter here) ming dang las kyis 'phrad: gnad de dang stabs ldan srid gyur na: khyed tshe chos gdul bya rim gyis 'byung: yul gsum la gter gnyis bstan gzhi 'dzug: don gnyis kyi mdzad pa mthar rgyas nges: brda go'am bde ba'i 'byung gnas ma: zhes zer bar snang:

ri bo che'i bla ser rnams kyi zhal ngo mi ldog tsam du 'khrul snang yig ris su bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// ༈ dus 'dzin me glang lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bzhi'i dgung mo thun gseng zhig tu: byi'u chung dong dmar zhig gis: ya ya: rnal 'byor bde skyong dbang mo: tshul mthun yid kyis bkod pa'i gnas der: bgrod pa'i dus ni brag 'dzin spre'u: gnam sman sprul pa'i mi mos bslu brid: rang gzhan stabs ka gzab pa gal che: thugs kyi ming chags gnas su gnyis skyes: la 'ur la 'ur rang chos bsgrub tshe: nam mkha'i dbang gzhu'i mdangs la ma zhen: las 'brel thugs bcud snying po'i 191) nyams len: dus babs padma ri nas lon mdzod: ka li'i sgra yis sa gsum g.yo tshe: rang gter gsang ba skor gsum zab gter: nye min ring nas padma'i ming gis: brda don gsal la ci cha ci yod: chos bdag bu lnga las kyis bskul nas: byi ba'i 'dzum gyi dus dang 'phrad nges: de la zab pa'i gdams khrid yongs rdzogs: sbas gsang med par bu la sprod dang: gter gnyis bstan pa de'i phyogs dar nges: de sogs rig pas rtog dpyod mdzod dang: 'phral 'phral bya ba ngang gis gsal nges: zhes zer snang 'char: bde ba'i rdo rjes so: ༈ sang sang: nga 'ong ba padma ljongs nas 'ong: gshog drug la ngal ba cang ma mchis: lho spo rong gi gsang gter khyod la dbang: ma ḍā ki'i ngag gsal khyod la dbang: ya ya: shar khu byug sngon mo lho ru bzhud: dpal rta mgrin sprul pa'i sems dpa' de: ( Dakini Secret letter here) ming 'dzin pa: dpral ba la hrīḥyig dmar po bkra: chos 'dzin gyis skyes bu a tsar dang: 'brog ban dang nam snying bai ro dang: rma thog dang g.yu sgra lang 192) 'gro sogs: las can gyi chos bdag bu dgur 'phrad: bstan 'gro ba'i bde skyid rim gyis sman: smad du ba sngon po nub la 'phyo: nub khu 'phang rtse drug phyogs nas 'gyed: mi bdud sprul zhig gis ma bslus na:

mgon 'phags pa'i sprul pas bod khams skyong: spo rong gi gter sgo de dus 'byed: a tsar la mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud gtod: 'brog ban gyi skye brgyud akṣa rar: rdzogs rim dang ma rgyud snying po gtod: g.yu sgra dang bai ro zung sprul la: tshe sgrub dang man ngag gsang khrid gtod: rma thog gi sprul pa lo ka'i ming: dpal de la rta mgrin lha dgu gtod: g.yu sgra yi sprul pa badzra ming: dpal de la mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa gtod: dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa kītti'i ming: dpal de la sems dpa'i thugs sgrub gtod: a tsa ra dang lang 'gro zung sprul la: surya'i ming mtha' 'dzum drug 'dzin: dpal de la zab chos yongs rdzogs gtod: mtsho rgyal gyi byin thob padma'i ming: dpal de la bka' srung chos skor gtod: da de sogs chos bdag skyes dbu rnams: sbrang ma yis rtsi bcud rol ba bzhin: rang skal gyi chos dang 'phrad par nges: rim gnyis kyi nyams len gnad zab na: don gnyis kyi mdzad pa tshe 'dir 'grub: don go'am bde ba'i 'byung gnas ma: nga 'gro dang 'ong med 193) rang snang ba: ma mkha' 'gro'i brda don khyod la gdamasaḥ de gsang zhing gsang ba a thaṃ rgya: zhes zer snang shar: me gla zla tshes la bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// ༈ 'byung 'gyur lung byang zur gsal mkha' 'gro kun gsal mas gdams pa: lho phyogs maṅga'i ming 'dzin gnas kyi sar: chu bo sba klong 'khrugs pa'i nye cha ru: khyed kyi gdul bya'i lhag ma de ru babs: khye'u chung bai ro'i byin thob cang shes 'dzin: padma dhwa dza phrin las dpal gyis phyug: slu byed mi mos brdzu bag rma byar 'gran: kī la ya yi srog bcud nyams blangs na: smon log sabta'i rkyen ngan dbyings su zhi: sa 'dzin dmar pos dug sbrul kha rlangs 'phyo: smad kyi du ba sngon pos yul gsum 'jig: nub kyi khu 'phang rang gi phyogs su 'thor: bdud sprul ( Dakini Secret letter

here) dang: smon lam log pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi mthus: 'dzam gling nyi zla chu 'dzin nag pos bsgribs: rkyen des ka na ka yi 'byung po dar: bod khams bde skyid chu yi gnyer dang mtshungs: bsod nams longs spyod dbang thang rim gyis nyams: cha lugs ma nges rgya sog hor 'dra'i chas: 194) spyod pa mi dge sna tshogs thabs kyis gsog: rang gzhan gnyis phung ngan 'gro'i sa bon 'debs: dkon mchog lha khang gsung rab rten bzhengs sogs: rtsis med lam kha'i rdo bzhin rgyang du bor: dus ngan phung rdzas gces pa'i srog dang brdo: bde 'dod sdug bsngal las la rtag tu spyod: shi tshad thams cad rgyal btsan 'dre rigs skye: dam sri bud med snying la zhugs pa yis: bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun 'dul khrims nyams: dam med log 'tsho'i zas la rtag tu spyod: bslab gsum tshul khrims na bun bzhin du yal: mdo sngags gnyis po me chu 'phrad bzhin du: ya ma zung gis bstan pa'i chom rkun byed: sngags pas mgo reg rab byung chas tsam 'dzin: bskyed rdzogs gding bral grong gseb khyi bzhin nyul: dge sbyong skya chas dmag jag las la brtson: bstan pa'i lag dmar dam sri grogs su 'grogs: mtha' mi rgya sog 'bod pa rang gis byed: mi 'dod la yog sna tshogs rang la sdang: dus ngan zer zhing spyod ngan mi dge bsgrub: de mthus bod khams skye 'gro thams cad kun: mi bde'i sdug bsngal na ra ka dang mtshungs: longs 195)spyod bsod nams srog gi gshed du babs: yul mi nye 'brel rtsod dang 'khrugs pa'i gzhi: chags sdang go ldog pha mar blo mi khel: bya ba thams cad mtha' med ngan song rgyu: de 'dra'i dus ngan snyigs ma snyigs ma'i dus: spyan gzigs phyag rdor pad 'byung sgrol ma dang: yi dam kun 'dus mkha' 'gro kun 'dus dang: bka' srung kun 'dus seng chen dpa' bo sogs: de dag rang rang sgrub phrin drag po'i las: mnan sreg zlog sgyur las mtha' man ngag rnams:

lag len gnad rnams ma nor tshul bzhin du: yul sde gcig min kun gyis bsgrub nus na: yul gru rang rang sgos kyi rkyen ngan dang: khyad par dus kyi 'khrugs pa kun zhi nas: bod 'bangs bde ba'i go skabs cung zhig shar: khyad par rigs gsum mgon dang padma 'byung: 'jigs sgrol 'phags ma tā re nyer gcig gi: sku brnyan bzhengs dang snying po rdo la bsko: sa dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas nyid du: rin chen gter gyi bum pa'i snying po bcas: yul gru'i rang phyogs nub dang byang ngos su: sa 196)yi bcud gso man ngag a tham rgya: siddhi yig drug tā re snying po dang: dus ngan 'jigs skyob gsol 'debs la sogs dang: skyabs 'gro sgrol ma le'u bdun ma sogs: ras sam shing shun rnams su legs bris te: ri bo'i rtse dang grong ngam grong khyer dang: gnas dgon dben khrod la sogs thams cad du: rlung dar btsugs na 'jigs dang sdug bsngal kun: ma lus zhi bar 'gyur ro bod 'bangs rnams: lus dal ma byed phyag bskor sgrib sbyong rem: ngag gi 'khyal tshig spongs la skyabs 'gro dang: rigs gsum snying po dang ni siddhi sgrongs: blo sems mi dge sna tshogs mdun ma bsu: snyigs dus 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon gcig pu: sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung gnas la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad pa drag po yis: gsol ba thob la sgom sgrub nyams len 'bungs: mi dge tshul bzhin spangs pa'i bden 'bras kyis: sbas gnas lhun grub ljongs su gnas thob nas: tshe 'dir mi gnas gtan srid legs thob nges: padma'i brgyud 'dzin gter bdag rnal 'byor tshogs: chos brgyad blos bor dben par sgrub tshugs zungs: ḍā ki'i bka' bzhin bstan 'gro ris med skyongs: gangs gsum ljongs gsum 197)gnas gsum gsang phug tu: brag gi spre'u'i lo ru dus babs gnad: smon log ( Dakini Secret letter here) rkyen gyis ma bsgyur na:

tshe yi gegs rkyen sel zhing bdun cur 'tsho: khwa ta rog po dmar ser tshos kyis bsgyur: rkyen des yul gnyis mi bde'i 'khrugs pa bgyid: cang shes 'dzin pa'i skyes bus ma dpyod na: nor bu'i 'od mdangs nyams pa'i grib kyis gos: mche ldan 'dzin ma sgyu ma'i bu mo des: dbang gzhu'i 'phrul gyis bdud rtsi dug tu 'gyur: lho rgyud nags khrod gnas pa'i gdong lnga pas: brtul zhugs ma nges dmar ser mdangs 'dzin pa'i: seng dkar khyu gcig smon lam dbang gis 'dzom: zab pa'i man ngag las ldan dpal du shar: dus tshigs dus kyi rten 'brel ma log cing: tshul bzhin gnad dang ldan par 'dzom gyur na: g.yu 'brug gtsug gi nor bu lon par nges: nyag la sngar med gser gyi me tog 'khrungs: 'bras bu'i bstan pa gyad kyi gtsug nor bzhin: mi mngon gab pa'i gnas su gyur pa yi: rkyen des srin mo spun gsum kha dar nas: yul gru gsum la khrag gi 198)mtsho mo 'khyil: pad 'byung sprul pa'i mthu yis ma 'dul na: tha ma bod khams phung ba'i chom rkun byed: nam mkha'i khri gdugs mun pa'i smag dang 'phrad: se phung sprul pas rgyal bstan thabs kyis bshig: sa yi bcud nyams lo thog 'bras mi 'byung: dmag 'khrugs mu ge nad yams la sogs dang: sde 'khrugs nang dme'i 'thab rtsod rgyun mi chad: padma'i mtsho la gser gyi ngang khyu 'khor: gser mig 'dzin pa mi gtsang lam du byings: mdo gsum thang du nya mo bye tshan thon: 'od dkar zla ba'i bdud rtsi'i bsil chab kyis: mi srun srin mo phrin las dbal gyis gzhom: khye'u chung 'brog mi bai ro g.yu sgra dang: lang gro la sogs rje 'bangs sprul pa yis: thabs rnams du mas bod khams re zhig skyob: snyigs dus sems can gter dang ma 'phrad na: rang bzo'i chos kyis grol ba thob mi srid: de phyir padma'i brgyud 'dzin rjes 'jug rnams: 'chi ba dran na gter chos nyams su longs:

'khor bar mi gnas dben rir sgrub tshugs zungs: dkor nag log 'tsho'i zas spongs slong mor brten: chos brgyad 'khrul 199)pa'i las la mgo ma 'khor: blo sna rtse gcig gu ru pad 'byung dang: mchog gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror gtod: tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob bo skal ldan rnams: legs nyes gsal ba'i brda 'di khyed la gdams: yal bar ma dor tsitta'i klong du sbos: 'phrul gyi brdzu bag 'phrul bzhin ngoms pa'i tshe: khyod kyang yul 'dir sdod pa'i gnas dben kyang: sa ma ra thi'i rten 'brel gyis bskul nas: phyogs min phyogs su bgrod la ci cha yod: skal ldan chos brgyud 'dzin pa de ru 'dus: srin bya nag pos ngar skad ma sgrogs na: yul der re zhig gnas na 'gro don 'byung: gsang grogs ( Dakini Secret letter here) 'phrad gyur na: tshe yi bar chad re zhig sel bar nges: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes shing mo phag gi lo'i zla tshes la mkha' 'gro kun gsal dbang mo yin skad pas de ltar zer snang 'char yang snang cha la bden rdzun cha chod dka' bas btang snyoms su bzhag yod skabs mi mkho dgu mkho'i rnal 'byor pa rang gi nye gnas shākya'i dge btsun tshul khrims rdo rjes yang yang nan cher bskul ngor bde ba'i rdo rjes 'khrul snang yig ris su 200)bris pa'o// dge'o// ༈ dus 'dzin shing glang lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i gnam gang nyi phyed yol dus su yod skabs: dbyings thig le 'od dkar gsal ba'i klong: skyabs 'khor lo'i mgon po las 'brel rtsal: dpal he ru ka pa'i chas ldan pa: ma mkha' 'gro gnyis bcas dbyings snang shar: zhal 'dzum pa'i tshul gyis 'di skad gsungs: tshur gson dang brtse ldan snying gi grogs: lam zab mo lhun grub 'od gsal la: gol shor dang nor sa'i 'phrang med kyang: rtsa rlung thig rgyas btab gnad gsang la: thabs mkhas pas nyams len 'di ltar mdzod: mi gzhan la blo gros gsal mi dgos:

nged thabs shes sngon gyi dam bcas bzhin: dus dus su nyams len gab 'khrugs rnams: ngas khyod la smra'o yid la zungs: rang rig mi 'gyur dbus mtha' bral: stong dbyings chos sku byang chub sems: 'gyu ba dngos med ye shes gsal: bde stong spros bral blo las 'das: zung 'jug rtogs pa mkha' ltar khyab: nyon mongs skyon bral ngang der grol: gang shar chos nyid 'khor lo ste: bsal bzhag mi dgos gdod nas dag: 'dir snang sgyu 201)ma'i dpe bcu bzhin: chags zhen 'khrul 'dzin gzhi la sangs: chos nyid don la som nyi bral: 'khrul snang 'khrul byed yul las 'das: gol shor nor ba'i 'dzin zhen bor: thams cad ro snyoms chos skur rtogs: sku gsum mnyam nyid ngang du klod: de ni khregs chod gsal 'debs yin: lus gnad gang bder shig ger zhog: rtsa gnad lus la gdab par mdzod: sgyu lus 'od skur grol ba'i gnad: ngag rlung ma bcos rang sar 'phen: rlung gnad ngag la gdab par mdzod: las rlung ye shes rlung du 'phos: sems nyid ma bcos ngang du skyongs: rig gnad sems la gdab par mdzod: sems nyid 'od gsal smin par byed: 'char ba yul gyi gnad gzer na: dbyings kyi ye shes lam du mngon: gzigs pa sgo yi gnad brtson na: dbyings snang thig le'i skabs 'byed byed: gzir ba rig pa'i gnad ldan na: gang snang ye shes grogs su 'char: ngag rlung rang sor 'phen pa yis: dag dang ma dag rlung skabs 'byed: sems dang sems byung shugs su 'phen: snang sems rig par grol ba'i gnad: chos nyid 'od gsal dbyings su 'phen: 202) rig pa dbyings thig mi 'bral gnad: las rlung dbu mar bcing ba yis: rlung bcu las su rung ba'i gnad: sems rtog rig par bcings ba yis: snang sems chos skur grol ba'i gnad: dbyings dang ye shes thig le gsum: ci bzhin ma nor gnad la res: gang snang gnyis 'dzin blo bor la: chos nyid mi 'gyur dgongs pa skyongs:

lhun grub 'od gsal ngang gis 'char: de sogs che long tsam yin pas: skabs skabs gsal 'debs nga yis smra: yang bdag gis smre sngags kyis mchi ma 'khrugs nas 'di skad zhus: dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med rig pa'i sku: rang rig don gyi bla ma he ru ka: snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon po las 'brel rtsal: thugs rje zhi ba'i dbyings su mi gzims par: mgon med nyam thag bdag la thugs rjes gzigs: sngon smon las 'brel bzang pos gter la dbang: yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i khyed dang 'phrad: myur lam gsang sngags spyod pa'i skal bar ldan: bogs 'byin brtan thob rlung sems dbu mar drangs: nang dbyings 'od gsal snang bzhi mtha' ru phyin: zung 'jug rig sku mngon gyur lam mchog brnyes: 'on kyang bsod nams dman dang bdud dbang gis: 203)rje khyed yul du mi bzhugs zhing du yibs: mgon med bdag ni gcig pur shul du bor: nyin mtshan bar med sems rtsa sdug gis naun: gsal byed dbang sgor chu rgyun bar med 'bebs: de 'dra'i sdug bsngal bsam tshe skyo ba skye: man ngag gdams khrid gnad gsang zhu sa med: gol shor nor gsum gegs sel su yis byed: kho mo'i las mtha' de ltar dgos pa yi: sngon las ngan pa'i rkyen dbang ci las byung: ye shes spyan ldan khyed kyis bstan du gsol: da ni myur du 'bral med thugs rjes zungs: zhes dang: yang bdag gis nyid sku dbyings su bsdus nas nyin zhag bco lnga tsam song skabs yang sprul gyi dgongs pa gtad pa e yin bsam pa'i rtags mtshan re byung bas gsal po zhig gsung du gsol zhus pas: yang dpa' bo'i zhal nas bdag nam yang khyed dang 'du 'bral med pas: nga sprul byis pa chung ngus khyed la dgos pa e yod mi shes gsungs: yang bdag gis nyid kyi zhal bzhes ltar bsod sprul rin po che'i thugs rten du nyid 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes pa de'i don dang ldan pa bka' drin mi chung bar zhu zhus pas:

yang 204)ḍā ki'i zhal nas 'di skad zer: he he: lho gser gyi ba dan 'od po che: byang mun pa'i khrod du sku bskyod na: lung chen gnyis 'dus pa'i g.yon zur na: ri khro bo 'gying 'dra'i g.yas zur na: khong sangs rgyas gling pa'i rnam rol gar: gter 'dzin pa shast+ra'i ming gis brgyan: chos zab pa'i rang skal dus su sprod: de'i gnad dang ldan par ma gyur na: 'dzum drug gis khur la ci cha yod: sku ye shes sgyu ma'i zlos gar ni: sngon tshe rabs las 'phro'i 'brel ba can: thog ma yi ming can mi mo la: sgyu 'phrul gyi zla zer nirmakaḥ g.yu 'brug gi zer dang ma 'phrad na: thabs mkhas na bstan pa'i nyi gzhon shar: blo rig pa dpyod shes mkhas gyur na: dus nam zhig mi 'gyang rang nor rnyed: da de dang de sogs rig pas dpyod: yul ldan pa'i skyes bu ma gtogs pa'i: khyod gang shar yul du mi 'doms par: sbas gsang dang ngag sgo bsdam pa gnad: ces zer nas thams cad dbyings snang thig le'i rol par mi snang bar gyur ro: ces pa 'di'ang 'khrul snang gab sbas su yod skabs gzhan tshig gi rjes su 'brangs nas lung bstan 'chal tshig tu shor 205)ba'i rkyen gyis skal ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa tshul khrims rdo rje dang tshogs rgyam gnyis kyis nan cher bskul ngor kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos 'khrul snang yig ris su bris pa dge'o// ༈ he he: nyams chung gi rgan mo'i bsam tshod la sbyar na: gter min gyi gter 'dra'i yig ris kyis ci byed: dus ngan gyi rang mtshang mi 'gyang bar ngoms dus: las ngan gyi sems can bdag 'dra yis mi thul: mdo sngags la mi gnas slob ngan re yod kyang: rang gzhan kun ngan song sa bon de red na: mtsho skyes kyi bla ma pad 'byung gi zhal nas: chos lam du zhugs kyang chos bred du song ba'i: skyon ldan gyi 'khor slob spang ba de gnad yin: rang gzhan kun dug chu'i 'dam rdzab la lhung nges:

zhes gsungs kyi rdo rje'i tshig zhor la bltas na: yul de dang de yi phyogs su ni nye bas: sngon las dbang drag po'i stobs shugs zhig med tshe: rang gcig pur nges med gnas yul du 'gro snyam: gnas ka ling ka yi 'byung po des bskul nas: lho gser gyi ba dan ci 'gyur ni mi shes: grogs bi ma'i sprul pa 'phrul ldan zhig med na: 206)grangs lnga phrag dgu yol dbang gzhu bzhin: dbyings nam mkhar thim la ci cha yod: seng dkar mo'i g.yu ral 'brug gis lon: dpa' bo yos khur ( Dakini Secret letter here) de sogs 'byung 'gyur bya ba la: yid 'khums nas gang shar rdzun ris su: sprang su kha badzra ming gis bris: ༈ gnyid 'od gsal 'dres pa'i snang cha la: yul zhing khams phun tshogs rnam dag dbus: 'od lnga ldan gzi brjid 'khrigs pa'i klong: nga'i skyabs gcig 'dren ston chos kyi rje: pha padma las 'brel yud tsam mjal: legs nyes kyi brda don sna tshogs zhus: grangs mang bas yid ngor mi gsal kyang: bu shī la badzra 'dod don du: brda 'phrul gyi rol mo 'di skad gsungs: ya ya: tsandan sdong po'i rtse na: gsung snyan rma bya'i bsgyur mkhan: mkha' lding gzhon nu'i stobs kyis: rang nor cung zhig lon par: dri bsung ngad pa'i ro la: skal ldan bung ba'i tshogs 'du: gter gnyis bstan pa gsal ba: brag gis spre'us bsu na: sgra brgya'i gzi mdangs de tsam: sngon smon las 'phro ldan pas: gter gnyis las gnyer dbang ba: pha yi bka' ltar 207)bsgrub dang: mi ring don gnyis 'byung nges: ngur smrig bstan la 'jug nas: ma bcos lcang lo ldan na: gnas skabs 'phral rkyen des sel: 'di 'og chu gsum 'dus pa: a yis brgyan pa'i yul du: khrims ldan dpa' bo'i ming can: dag snang chos skor 'byed pa'i: rten 'brel gnad zab legs 'ong: dam sri'i cho 'phrul ngoms pas: lo 'dir cung zhing 'tshe bas: sel byed kun 'dus 'jigs bzlog:

'byung bzhi gang la byas kyang: sa dpal gnad la brten dgos: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sgrub pa: 'phrul gyi cho ga zab dgos: gnad ldan tshul bzhin bsgrub na: 'phral rkyen de yis sel nges: g.yu 'brug dung gi rwa la: ha lo'i ku muta bzhad pas: blo ldan rig pas dpyod la: stabs ka gzab pa gal che: byang gi mi sdug bdag pos: tsandan dri bsung bcom pas: khrims kyi ba gam g.yo tshe: blo ngan kha ta rog pos: gzi mdangs rma byar 'gran 'ong: de dus nga yi zab sgrub: brtson 'grus lcag gis bskul nas: zab gsum gnad du bsnun 208)na: na ngan g.yul las rgyal nges: de dang de sogs spyod dang: 'phral 'phral brda don gsal 'ong: gzhan la gu hya a thaṃ:

ces pa 'di yang snying gi bu gcig shī la badzra gyi bzhed don du 'khrul 'byams mdo med su kha badzra gyis ser dgon dben khrod nas bris pa'o// ༈ dus 'dzin me stag lo'i zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin gling bu'i sgra tshor bas rkyen byas te bla ma yid bzhin nor bu shin tu dran nas ngu zhing bsdad yod pas: gter sgrom gyi steng nas bya ze mo lta bu'i gtsug sgro shin tu ring ba kha dog sna tshogs su bkra ba zhig byung nas 'di skad zer: ya ya a lcam bzhin legs la: khyed gcig pur sems gcong ci'i phyir dgos: nga bde bde mkha' 'gro'i grong khyer nas: mdangs lnga ldan thig ler brdzus te 'ongasaḥ khyed yid gcong mi dgos ngas grogs byed: gnas lnga yi mkha' 'gro dgyes skong phyir: bcud 'dzin gyi bu mo bcus nyer drangs: bzhin ldan gyi stobs rtsal yul ltar bgrod: so gnyis kyi zla ba'i 'od zer dang: bcu phrag bzhi ni nyi ma'i snying po gnyis: de brda dang brda lan rten 'brel bsgrigs: zung 209)'jug gi pho nya'i rtsal rdzogs te: mdangs gcig grogs gcig gis byed lags sam: de'i stobs kyis 'khrul snang gnas su dag: rnam smin gyi lus dwangs sku ru smin: sku gsum gyi 'bras bu gcig char rdzogs: don go'am sngags kyi rnal 'byor ma: zhes zer bas: bdag gis smras pa: snang ba bden med kyi 'khrul khang na: gzugs snang ma nges pa'i ri mo shar: 'phrul bya lnga ldan gyi 'od can khyed: gnas gang nas 'ong dang da gang 'gro: don ci'i phyir 'dir yongs bdag la smos: nga grogs po khyod kyis dgos pa med: don snang stong gnyis med kyi ye shes 'di: lhan skyes kyi pho nya bde chen mchog: des mi chog grogs pos ci zhig byed: nga 'dus byas chos la skyo ba skyes: pha bla mas bor nas lo gsum song: bshes med kyi dwa'u gcig pur lus: las gci la thug kyang skyabs mgon med:

mdze nad kyis thebs pa'i skyes bu bzhin: 'khor slob mas bskyur nas lo gsum yin: sems sdug gis myos kyang re sa med: nag can gyi mi bzhin sa mthar phud: pha'i gdan sar ma thon lo gsum song: dam ldan 210)pa'i mched grogs dang ma 'phrad: skyid sdug gi rnam grangs bshad sa med: sems sdug gi zin nas lo gsum song: skyo rog gi grogs po mi bsam do: snying rlung gis zin nas lo gsum song: 'dir snang la 'dug na mi snyam gyi: mi gral nas phud nas lo gsum yin: gzhan don zhig e 'grub mi bsam gi: sems 'khri shing gi bu yis bskyur nas song: da brgyud 'dzin zhig byung na mi snyam gi: rgyab pha ming med pa'i skyon dbang gis: mi kun gyis dor nas lo gsum yin: da chos brgyad zhig e 'grub mi bsam gi: las ji ltar byas kyang sdug bsngal rgyu: da bsam zhing bsam na skyo ba 'phel: yul gang du bsdad kyang bla ma brten: chos gdams ngag gsal tshe bla ma dran: shar rta bdun dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i tshe: pha bla ma'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dran: 'od zer gyis mun khang sangs pa'i dus: pha bla ma'i gsang gsum yon tan dran: nyi 'od kyis 'gro ba'i bde skyid byed: pha bla ma'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis: gdams ngag gi byin rlabs bstsal ba dran: de dgung mo nub rir phyogs pa'i dus: pha bdag gi mgon du byon pa 'di: slar mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa dran: da de sogs las dang bya byed kun: pha bla ma dran pa'i gsos su gyur: nga gcig pur sems gcong de yis byed: khyod 'phrul bya shes rab blo ldan pa: sems bag phobs bdag gi ngag gsal nyon: pha 211)padma las 'brel chos sku dang: nga chos nyid bde skyong dbang mo gnyis: don bde stong mchog tu mi 'gyur klong: dbyings ye shes 'du 'bral med mod kyang: gang 'dul gyi gdul bya'i 'gro ba'i ngor: thugs rje yi phrin las shar ba'i tshe: dus nam yang 'bral med smon lam btab:

de de bzhin 'grub pa'i dpang po ru: khyed ye shes lha yis mdzad du gsol: thabs shes rab 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel gyis: zab gter gyi bstan pas sa steng khyab: lus can gyi 'gro ba ma lus pa: mi gnas kyi gtan srid myur zin nas: gnas zangs mdog dpal rir skye bar shog: don go'am 'phrul ldan lha yi bya: ces smras pas: kho na re: ting ting go: ting ting go: pa ra mi ta tsitta mant+ra: a nu rwa ga ya mi ho st+waṃ: he sa ya na sa ma ra sa: bidyā ra dza a na ya hoḥ de don khrol naḥ gab sbas tshig yin: nub kyi rgya stag: rten 'brel ri mo: a darsha yi: gzugs la ngoms dus: tshe chos gdul bya: lhag ma skyongs dang: ma nges dus bzhi'i: rtags tshad rdzogs dus: dpal ri'i zhing du: las 'brel 212)rtsal gyis: bsu ba brtsams nas: ma dang mkha' 'gros: ye shes dar lam: 'phrul ldan nga yis: sna la drangs yong: da dung yid la: bcags pa'i yul der: yun ring sdod grabs: ma byed i go: byang gi dug sbrul: lce gnyis ngoms dus: brda don gsal yong: ka li'i 'phrul gyi: go cha ma zhan: 'phral 'phral legs nyes: de yis sel nges: brag gi spre'us: sgyu rtsal ngoms dus: byang phyogs mun pa'i: khrod du ma bzhugs: gyi na'i tshul gyis: ma nges nges pa'i: gnas gsum 'grims na: bzhi bcur 'phen srid: akṣa shrīs: smon lam bsdus na: a nanta yis: zlos gar rol nas: bstan 'gro'i bde skyid: nub nas shar nges: lho nas chas pa'i: yal ga'i ri dwags : rma bya'i 'phrul gyi: rang mdangs ngoms na: rang nor ma phog: mi ring rnyed 'ong: smon lam las kyi: 'brel zab yod pa'i: rigs ldan 'byung tshe: btang snyoms ma mdzad: tshe chos gdul bya: de la rag las: phan tshun thabs mkhas: shes rab ma zhan: 'jig rten mi yi: ngo srung bor la: brtul zhugs spyod pas: bstan 'gro'i don mdzod: de dang de 213) sogs: stabs ldan med tshe: sgyu ma'i bu mos: sgyu 'phrul bshig nas: sgyu rtsal ldan pas:

dbyings la bzhud do: gab sbas tshig 'di: tsittar gu hya: rig pas dpyod la: rten dang 'brel 'byung: gzhan rkyen sabta'i: dbang du ma gtong: gter gnyis bstan pa: khyod la dbang bas: legs nyes gang byung: thad kar chod la: pha gcig bla ma: thugs kyis ma gtong ཿ dus kun brtse bas: brda byang gsal 'ong: ma nges dpal ri: padma 'od du: thabs shes dbyer med: lhan du 'tshogs nges: de sogs rig pas: dpyod shes mdzod dang: dus dus nga yis: brda gsal ngoms yong: nga 'gro bde bde: mkha' 'gro'i gling la: shugs ldan rtsal gyis: gnam 'phang bcad nas: dbyings kyi sprul pa: dbyings la bzhud do: ces zer ba dang mnyam du: 'od dkar dmar gnyis su gyur nas bdag gi dran 'dus kyi 'khor lor thim mo: sa ma ya: gtam 'di tsho dgos med nges pa'i tshig: gnas tsittar rgya yis btab yod kyang ཿ khong shī la badzra thugs glen pas: bskul lcag gis 'dug 214) 177) bskal pa shing bya lo pa'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i dgung thun skabs su thun chung zhig gi snang ba la thig le sngon po shar ba'i klong du: yul yangs pa can yid du 'ong ba me tog sna tshogs dang bya rigs mi 'dra ba mang pos gu ru ha ri ni sa'i sgra di ri ri sgrogs nas thams cad dga' ba'i nyams can sha stag gnas pa dang: de'i dbus su 'ja' 'od kyi dgur khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du bdag gi bla ma padma las 'brel rtsal dngaḥ bdud 'joms rdo rje: ngo mi shes pa'i bla ma grub thob mang po dang: mkha' 'gro bde ba'i go cha dang: ral gri 'bar ma: gsal byed dbang mo rnams kyi gtsos mkha' 'gro mang po dang: gzhan yang dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas bdud rtsi sman sgrub mdzad kyin 'dug pas: bdag der lhags nas yid bzhin nor bu'i phyag la 'jus nas shin tu gdung sems drag pos smre sngags bton pas dpa' bo chen pos zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas thugs brtse ba chen pos 'di skad gsungs:

e ma rigs ldan brtse ba'i grogs: thugs ngal 178)ma mdzad thugs rgya glod: nged cag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i grong: gzhan na med do rang snang nyid: chos nyid gcig gi cho 'phrul las: tha dad med do rigs ldan ma: tshogs kyi gral du bzhugs dang sproḥ gsungs nas thugs brtse brtse mdzad nas chang ka pā la gang gnang nas skus gar bsgyur te: he ru ka rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras pa: phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnol thabs su 'dzin cing spyan bar snang la ha re gzigs nas 'di skad gsungs: hūm̐ hrīḥ mi 'gyur mi shigs rdo rje'i sku: dwangs gsal 'od kyi phung por ldan: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: 'gyur med sku yi dbang thob shog: dharma kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐ hrīḥ brjod bral sngags kyi rang gdangs gsung: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: bdag gi gsung dang gnyis med pa'i: gsung gsang mi bzad dbang thob shog: dharma wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag rang byung chos kyi sku: gnyis med thugs gsang 'khor lo'i dbang: rig pa'i bu la bskur ba yis: bdag gi thugs dang gnyis med pa'i: bskur thob bral ba'i dbang thob shog: dharma tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: a 179)a ā: zhes gsungs ma thag tu bdag tha mal gyi rtog pa glo bur du 'gags nas sngar gyi bag chags 'ga' sad nas: skad cig gis rdo rje phag mo'i skur lam gyis gsal nas yab kyi skur 'khril nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rig sku mngon du gyur nas yab yum gnyis med kyi dgongs pa yun gcig skabs: 'khor gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig tu 'di skad gsungs: a haṃ siddhi su kha st+wam̐: a la la ho ngo mtshar che: gsang sngags bdag po he ru ka: ye shes sku brnyes rdo rje 'chang: ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos: dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'byung gnas che: dpa' bo yab yum gsang chen mdzod: dngos grub 'byung gnas khyod la bstod:

gsang sngags lam mchog bla na med: rgyal kun thugs gsang nye lam mchog: mngon gyur gding thob rig sku brnyes: rdo rje dbang nyid la bstod: lha las lhag gyur zung 'jug sku: sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor kun gyi rje: sku dang ye shes dbyings su zlum: mngon rdzogs rgyal po khyod la bstod: ces gsungs nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bshams nas dkyil 'khor 180)gtso bo bdud 'joms he ru ka yab yum 'od kyi rnam par gyur te dpa' bo nyid la thim ma thag tu skus gar bsgyur nas he ru ka cad te'u bhan thod 'dzin pa rnal 'byor rol pa'i cha byad can du gyur nas: a haṃ: yab yum reg pa 'phrad pa sku rdo rje: snang stong dbyer med bum dbang ngo bor rdzogs: byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs gsung rdo rje: gsal stong dbyer med gsang dbang ngo bor rdzogs: dkar dmar thig le zhal mjal thugs rdo rje: bde stong dbyer med sher dbang ngo bor rdzogs: lhan skyes ye rig ye shes rdo rjair smin: rig stong dbyer med tshig dbang ngo bor rdzogs: bskur thob bral ba don dam gsang ba'i dbang: rigs ldan ḍā ki khyod la bskur ba yis: rags pa lus dang phra ba rtsa khams dag: rags pa ngag dang phra ba rlung khams smin: rags pa sems dang phra ba thig le rdzogs: sgo gsum bag chags rtog sgrib kun bral nas: rnam smin tshe dbang phyag chen lhun grub kyi: go 'phang mngon gyur don gyi dbang thob shog: ces gsungs nas spyan hrig ger bdag la gzigs nas cung zad dgongs pa gtad pa'i mthar: 'di ni thabs shes snying po don dam pa gsang ba'i 181)dbang bzhi pa bskur ba yin pas gzhan la ma bstan cig: dus la babs tshe 'o cag gnyis 'dzom 'ong: de'i bar du snang ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i thabs mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i yab dang 'grogs shig gsungs: de nas rdo rje karma mkha' 'gro zhi ba mtshos dkyil 'khor gyi shar nas tshogs kyi drang ba thogs nas dbyangs snyan gdangs kyis:

a hoḥ skye med rang byung don dam chos sku yi zhing na: gzugs snang dag pa rab 'byams thabs shes kyi dkyil 'khor: zag med bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsi la rol nas: bde stong dag pa rab 'byams dngos grub kyang zhu'o: rtsal snang dag pa rab 'byams dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro: 'dod don dag pa rab 'byams bdud rtsi la= zhen bral dag pa rab 'byams dngos= snod bcud dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa: rang byung dag par rab 'byams bdud= snang rtog dag pa rab 'byams dngos= rang snang dag pa 'og min nyams dga' yi gnas na: mched lcam dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje yi spun grogs: thabs shes myang grol bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod la rol nas: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams dngos grub de zhu'o: ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres nas: 182)'ja' lus chos sku 'grub pa'i gdams pa rang zhu'o: zhes gsungs nas thams cad kyis rang rang gi rigs dang gzungs ma rnams kyis kyang glu gar mdzad nas tshogs kyi dga' ston la rol: de nas bdag gis bsam pa la 'di rnams yid bzhin nor bu'i sku'i bkod pa yin par 'dra: da dung zhing khams su zhig gzhan du e yod: bdag kyang phyir mi 'gro zhing 'dir lhag dgos bsam pas: nyid kyi zhal nas: e ma gson dang rigs ldan ma: zhing dang gzhal yas lha'i rnam rol: chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi rtsal: rang byung ye shes de ka'o: logs na med do shes par mdzod: ces gsungs nas sku gcig gis bkod pa lnga mdzad nas dbus su rdo rje he ru ka yab yum: shar du buddha he ru ka yab yum: lho ru ratna he ru ka yab yum: nub tu padma he ru ka: byang du las kyi he ru ka rnams rang rang gi yum dang sras 'khor thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi rol pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa du mar spros nas bzhugs pa la: bdag gis shin tu dad mos drag pos phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad zhus: skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du:

rig 'dzin bla ma khyed dang mi 'bral zhing: rim pa gnyis kyi lam mchog mthar phyin nas: bde stong phyag 183)rgya chen po'i sa thob shog: thabs shes zung 'jug ting 'dzin la brten nas: 'di nas 'jig rten 'og tu bdag nyid kyang: mkha' 'gro mi yi gzugs can nye rgyu'i grogs: dpa' bo khyed kyi dgyes pa bskyed pa'i yum: bdag gyur smon lam mthu yis 'phrad par shog: 'phrad nas bar chad rkyen dbang mi 'gro zhing: sku tshe mthar phyin bstan 'gro'i don bsgrubs nas: rgyal ba'i mdzad pa yongs su 'grub par shog: gsang gter lde mig rtsa ba'i chos bdag dang: las ldan bu slob skyes bu la sogs pa: lhan 'dzoms bar chad 'gal zla med pa ru: bden gnyis bslu med nus pas 'grub par shog: bdag la bzang ngan 'brel bcas 'gro ba kun: dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar: rig 'dzin bla ma khyed dang mi 'bral zhing: zab gter rgya mtsho'i dpal la longs spyod nas: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zhes gsol ba btab pa'i mthar a a āḥ gsungs nas bkod pa rnams gcig tu bsdus te: lha nyid rang la rang nyid lha: thams cad ye shes gcig gi 'phrul: nga yi bkod pa brjod las 'das: snang rtog lha yi phyag rgyar 184)rdzogs: sgra grags bde chen rdo rje'i gsung: dran rtog chos nyid de bzhin nyid: gnyis med thugs kyi thig ler chub: tha dad med do rigs kyi bu: zhes gsungs nas shog dril gcig gnang ste: de gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i chos skor red: dus babs rten 'brel ldan na brda khrol shin tu zab 'ong gsungs ma thag mkha' 'gro gnyis kyis bdag gi lag pa g.yas g.yon du 'jus nas 'di skad zer: e ma rigs ldan ḍā ki lha yi lcam: khyod thugs sun skyo ngal che ba yis: zhing 'dir byon na ngas grogs byed: nged cag mched lcam dam tshig ldan: zab bcud gdams pa 'di na lhag: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa yod:

dam nyams grib kyi skyon dang bral: dpa' bo dang ni mkha' 'gro yi: grogs bzang zhing 'dir lhag par yod: 'o cag mched lcam dam re gtsang: nyes pa'i skyon gyis gos pa med: gnas 'dir yon tan bsam mi khyab: 'gro don bstan pa zhing du lhag: 'di ru bzhugs na don gnyis po: ma 'bad rang byung 'grub pa legs: 'jig rten mi sems bdud kyis bsgyur: chos bzhin bsgrub pa nyin skar tsam: bla slob dam tshig sdom mi bsrung: bde skyid la kha'i na bun 'dra: 'gro don 'ong ba 185)lta zhog dang: rang gzhan nyams pa'i skyon gyis gos: de sogs 'phral rkyen du ma yis: skyo sun thugs ngal rgyun chad med: de'i phyir da ni zhing du byon: zhes zer: bdag gi bsam pa dga' ya ler song nas da phyir mi 'gro bar dpa' bo nyid kyi drung du 'dug dgos snyam yang lan ci yang ma smras par yud cig gnas pas: yang nga rang gi grogs mched dang grogs su gyur pa 'gas mgrin gcig tu 'di skad zer: kyai: ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro dgongs: bdag cag rnams kyi skyabs gcig pu: gter chen bla ma zhing du 'dren: mi re'i khog nas snying re phyungs: mgon med bdag cag shul du bor: chos dang gdams pa zhu sa med: da res mkha' 'gro zhing du 'dren: nged cag rnams kyis ji ltar byed: zab pa'i dam chos su la zhu: zab gter 'dzin skyong su yis byed: skyabs dang re sa su la 'cha': zhing du byon pa'i 'os med pas: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzhugs gsol zhu: zhes brjod pa dang: yang mkha' 'gro gnyis kyis: gson dang rdo rje'i mched po rnams: khyed rnams dam tshig ldan pa yis: da res zhing 'dir lhan du 'tshogs: smon lam ldan pas spro ba bskyed: 186)da lan khyed rnams zhu ba bzhin: gcig gam gnyis gsum bzhi 'phrul yig: de phan zhing 'dir dus babs yin: mkha' 'gro'i bka' la 'da' ba med: zer nas dpa' bo chen po'i phyag g.yas g.yon la thim:

de nas rim bzhin yongs rdzogs sku la thim nas grogs mkha' 'gro gnyis dang dpa' bo nyid rang dang bcas yud tsam bzhugs par bdag gis phyag phul nas 'di skad zhus: kye ma kyi hud 'gro 'dul thugs rje can: mgon med nyam thag bdag la brtse bas zungs: bdag ni 'jig rten yul du ci phyir 'gro: skyabs dang re sa mgon dang dpung gnyen med: dus dang rten 'brel bdud dbang rkyen khar 'chor: rang 'dris ma gtogs kun gyis brnyas dmod byed: dam gtsang bu slob rnams la skur pa 'debs: gter gnyis 'gro don 'ong ba phar la zhog: kun gyis log lta'i gzhi ru gyur pa las: 'dzin skyong spel ba'i nus pa bdag la med: snying gi dwangs ma rje khyed zhing du byon: snying rje'i yul gyur bdag 'dras ji ltar byed: man ngag zab pa'i gdams pa zhu sa med: kho mo'i snying gtam nyams len su la zhu: sdug bsngal mi bzod srog la thug pa byung: da ni cis kyang 187)'gro mi dgos par zhus: 'jig rten yul du bdag 'dra'i 'gro don dka': zab gter rten 'brel sna kha bdud kyis bsgyur: grogs dang chos bdag gzhan rkyen kho nar song: gal te rten 'brel dbang gis grogs 'phrad kyang: dpa' bo khyed 'dra lta bu lta zhog dang: thig le dbab 'dren don ldan go bar dka': thabs shes zung 'jug rig sku lta zhog dang: lan chags bu brgyud sa bon rgyun chad med: myur lam zab mo'i dgos don phar zhog dang: gzugs byad tsam la chags shing 'khor bar skye: dag smin rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu phar zhog dang: nyin mtshan bar med chags sems rgyun chad med: snang stong dbyer med snying po phar zhog dang: lo shas zla shas tsam gyis gnyis phung 'grub: de 'drar bsam na bdag 'dras 'gro don dka': gu ru padma'i smon lam mthu btsan pas: bco lnga nas bzung rang yul rgyab tu bor: dpa' bo khyod nyid rigs kyi bdag por khur: rtsa brgyad dus su nyid kyis rjes su bzung:

rim pa gnyis kyi lam mchog mthar phyin mdzad: khyad par nang don ye shes mngon sum du: sad cing zab gter chos sgo du ma 'byed: 188)gter gnyis bstan pa mthar rgyas 'gro ba'i don: rgya chen yong ba'i smon lam 'phro ldan kyang: dus dbang smon log bdud kyi dbang du song: da ni bsam zhing bsam na skyo ba skyes: 'gro don mi 'ong 'khor ba'i bsnon pa byed: grogs kyang mi bsam khyed 'dra shin tu dkon: dpa' bo khyed kyis myur tu rjes bzung nas: sngon gyi rjes brtse yal bar ma dor bar: bde skyong dbang mo thugs rjes bzung du gsol: 'jig rten khams su mi 'gro bka' gnang zhu: zhes phyag la 'jus nas drag tu dus shing zhus pas thugs brtse mdzad nas 'di skad gsungs: e ma rigs ldan brtse ba'i grogs: thugs sun skyo ngal ma mdzad ang: nga 'gro dang 'ong med chos sku'i ngang: dus nam yang 'du 'bral ga la yod: klong rig dbyings 'od gsal ngang skyongs dang: nga chos byings mkha' klong yangs par shar: da dbyings kyi rol par dbyings la bzhugs: gsungs nas gtso 'khor gsum po 'od thig gi rnam par gyur nas rang gi snying gar thim par snang: sa ma ya: ha ha/ gang gi slob 'bangs kun gyi tha shal ba// mdo med chos med bde skyong dbang mo yis// 'khrul snang zad med nyin mtshan bar med pas// 'khrul 189)tshig yig ris bris pa dgos med kyang*// shī la badzra nan chags chos bskul ngor// mdo med 'chol mos 'khrul snang yig ris bris// rang la dad mos yod pa'i bu slob mchog /shī la badzra la sogs mched grogs rnams// thugs kyi bzhed don cung zhig phul ba dge dge'o// ༈ ( Dakini Secret letter here) dbyings mi 'gyur thig le'i mkha' klong nas: gdangs rang byung 'phrul gyi brda don ngoms: shar rta bdun dkyil 'khor lho ru 'phen: phag nag po'i 'khun pas yul gsum 'jigs: dbyar rnga yi rang nor gtsug tu mdzes:

srin bya yi mdangs ltar 'gran la chas: byang mun pa'i khrod nas glog dmar 'phyo: gnyis skyes kyi mdangs dang ma bral gal: brag spre'us yal ka'i ri dwags la: mdog dmar ser rdzas kyis bslu brid ngoms: gdong lnga yi rang tshugs ma zin na: lha dmar pos rgol ba rang la sdang: gnas chu gnyis 'dus pa'i g.yas zur na: bya thang dkar 'gying 'dra'i g.yon ngos su: chos pusti brtsegs pa'i lte ba ru: dpal 190)rta mgrin lha dgu'i zab sgrub ni: gnam lcags kyi sgrom dang rdor phur yod: dus ri mo can gyi mjug tu gsal: dpa' bo ( Dakini Secret letter here) ming dang las kyis 'phrad: gnad de dang stabs ldan srid gyur na: khyed tshe chos gdul bya rim gyis 'byung: yul gsum la gter gnyis bstan gzhi 'dzug: don gnyis kyi mdzad pa mthar rgyas nges: brda go'am bde ba'i 'byung gnas ma: zhes zer bar snang: ri bo che'i bla ser rnams kyi zhal ngo mi ldog tsam du 'khrul snang yig ris su bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// ༈ dus 'dzin me glang lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bzhi'i dgung mo thun gseng zhig tu: byi'u chung dong dmar zhig gis: ya ya: rnal 'byor bde skyong dbang mo: tshul mthun yid kyis bkod pa'i gnas der: bgrod pa'i dus ni brag 'dzin spre'u: gnam sman sprul pa'i mi mos bslu brid: rang gzhan stabs ka gzab pa gal che: thugs kyi ming chags gnas su gnyis skyes: la 'ur la 'ur rang chos bsgrub tshe: nam mkha'i dbang gzhu'i mdangs la ma zhen: las 'brel thugs bcud snying po'i 191) nyams len: dus babs padma ri nas lon mdzod: ka li'i sgra yis sa gsum g.yo tshe: rang gter gsang ba skor gsum zab gter: nye min ring nas padma'i ming gis: brda don gsal la ci cha ci yod: chos bdag bu lnga las kyis bskul nas: byi ba'i 'dzum gyi dus dang 'phrad nges: de la zab pa'i gdams khrid yongs rdzogs: sbas gsang med par bu la sprod dang:

gter gnyis bstan pa de'i phyogs dar nges: de sogs rig pas rtog dpyod mdzod dang: 'phral 'phral bya ba ngang gis gsal nges: zhes zer snang 'char: bde ba'i rdo rjes so: ༈ sang sang: nga 'ong ba padma ljongs nas 'ong: gshog drug la ngal ba cang ma mchis: lho spo rong gi gsang gter khyod la dbang: ma ḍā ki'i ngag gsal khyod la dbang: ya ya: shar khu byug sngon mo lho ru bzhud: dpal rta mgrin sprul pa'i sems dpa' de: ( Dakini Secret letter here) ming 'dzin pa: dpral ba la hrīḥyig dmar po bkra: chos 'dzin gyis skyes bu a tsar dang: 'brog ban dang nam snying bai ro dang: rma thog dang g.yu sgra lang 192) 'gro sogs: las can gyi chos bdag bu dgur 'phrad: bstan 'gro ba'i bde skyid rim gyis sman: smad du ba sngon po nub la 'phyo: nub khu 'phang rtse drug phyogs nas 'gyed: mi bdud sprul zhig gis ma bslus na: mgon 'phags pa'i sprul pas bod khams skyong: spo rong gi gter sgo de dus 'byed: a tsar la mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud gtod: 'brog ban gyi skye brgyud akṣa rar: rdzogs rim dang ma rgyud snying po gtod: g.yu sgra dang bai ro zung sprul la: tshe sgrub dang man ngag gsang khrid gtod: rma thog gi sprul pa lo ka'i ming: dpal de la rta mgrin lha dgu gtod: g.yu sgra yi sprul pa badzra ming: dpal de la mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa gtod: dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa kītti'i ming: dpal de la sems dpa'i thugs sgrub gtod: a tsa ra dang lang 'gro zung sprul la: surya'i ming mtha' 'dzum drug 'dzin: dpal de la zab chos yongs rdzogs gtod: mtsho rgyal gyi byin thob padma'i ming: dpal de la bka' srung chos skor gtod: da de sogs chos bdag skyes dbu rnams: sbrang ma yis rtsi bcud rol ba bzhin: rang skal gyi chos dang 'phrad par nges: rim gnyis kyi nyams len gnad zab na: don gnyis kyi mdzad pa tshe 'dir 'grub: don go'am bde ba'i 'byung gnas ma:

nga 'gro dang 'ong med 193) rang snang ba: ma mkha' 'gro'i brda don khyod la gdamasaḥ de gsang zhing gsang ba a thaṃ rgya: zhes zer snang shar: me gla zla tshes la bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// ༈ 'byung 'gyur lung byang zur gsal mkha' 'gro kun gsal mas gdams pa: lho phyogs maṅga'i ming 'dzin gnas kyi sar: chu bo sba klong 'khrugs pa'i nye cha ru: khyed kyi gdul bya'i lhag ma de ru babs: khye'u chung bai ro'i byin thob cang shes 'dzin: padma dhwa dza phrin las dpal gyis phyug: slu byed mi mos brdzu bag rma byar 'gran: kī la ya yi srog bcud nyams blangs na: smon log sabta'i rkyen ngan dbyings su zhi: sa 'dzin dmar pos dug sbrul kha rlangs 'phyo: smad kyi du ba sngon pos yul gsum 'jig: nub kyi khu 'phang rang gi phyogs su 'thor: bdud sprul ( Dakini Secret letter here) dang: smon lam log pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi mthus: 'dzam gling nyi zla chu 'dzin nag pos bsgribs: rkyen des ka na ka yi 'byung po dar: bod khams bde skyid chu yi gnyer dang mtshungs: bsod nams longs spyod dbang thang rim gyis nyams: cha lugs ma nges rgya sog hor 'dra'i chas: 194) spyod pa mi dge sna tshogs thabs kyis gsog: rang gzhan gnyis phung ngan 'gro'i sa bon 'debs: dkon mchog lha khang gsung rab rten bzhengs sogs: rtsis med lam kha'i rdo bzhin rgyang du bor: dus ngan phung rdzas gces pa'i srog dang brdo: bde 'dod sdug bsngal las la rtag tu spyod: shi tshad thams cad rgyal btsan 'dre rigs skye: dam sri bud med snying la zhugs pa yis: bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun 'dul khrims nyams: dam med log 'tsho'i zas la rtag tu spyod: bslab gsum tshul khrims na bun bzhin du yal: mdo sngags gnyis po me chu 'phrad bzhin du: ya ma zung gis bstan pa'i chom rkun byed: sngags pas mgo reg rab byung chas tsam 'dzin: bskyed rdzogs gding bral grong gseb khyi bzhin nyul:

dge sbyong skya chas dmag jag las la brtson: bstan pa'i lag dmar dam sri grogs su 'grogs: mtha' mi rgya sog 'bod pa rang gis byed: mi 'dod la yog sna tshogs rang la sdang: dus ngan zer zhing spyod ngan mi dge bsgrub: de mthus bod khams skye 'gro thams cad kun: mi bde'i sdug bsngal na ra ka dang mtshungs: longs 195)spyod bsod nams srog gi gshed du babs: yul mi nye 'brel rtsod dang 'khrugs pa'i gzhi: chags sdang go ldog pha mar blo mi khel: bya ba thams cad mtha' med ngan song rgyu: de 'dra'i dus ngan snyigs ma snyigs ma'i dus: spyan gzigs phyag rdor pad 'byung sgrol ma dang: yi dam kun 'dus mkha' 'gro kun 'dus dang: bka' srung kun 'dus seng chen dpa' bo sogs: de dag rang rang sgrub phrin drag po'i las: mnan sreg zlog sgyur las mtha' man ngag rnams: lag len gnad rnams ma nor tshul bzhin du: yul sde gcig min kun gyis bsgrub nus na: yul gru rang rang sgos kyi rkyen ngan dang: khyad par dus kyi 'khrugs pa kun zhi nas: bod 'bangs bde ba'i go skabs cung zhig shar: khyad par rigs gsum mgon dang padma 'byung: 'jigs sgrol 'phags ma tā re nyer gcig gi: sku brnyan bzhengs dang snying po rdo la bsko: sa dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas nyid du: rin chen gter gyi bum pa'i snying po bcas: yul gru'i rang phyogs nub dang byang ngos su: sa 196)yi bcud gso man ngag a tham rgya: siddhi yig drug tā re snying po dang: dus ngan 'jigs skyob gsol 'debs la sogs dang: skyabs 'gro sgrol ma le'u bdun ma sogs: ras sam shing shun rnams su legs bris te: ri bo'i rtse dang grong ngam grong khyer dang: gnas dgon dben khrod la sogs thams cad du: rlung dar btsugs na 'jigs dang sdug bsngal kun: ma lus zhi bar 'gyur ro bod 'bangs rnams: lus dal ma byed phyag bskor sgrib sbyong rem: ngag gi 'khyal tshig spongs la skyabs 'gro dang:

rigs gsum snying po dang ni siddhi sgrongs: blo sems mi dge sna tshogs mdun ma bsu: snyigs dus 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon gcig pu: sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung gnas la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad pa drag po yis: gsol ba thob la sgom sgrub nyams len 'bungs: mi dge tshul bzhin spangs pa'i bden 'bras kyis: sbas gnas lhun grub ljongs su gnas thob nas: tshe 'dir mi gnas gtan srid legs thob nges: padma'i brgyud 'dzin gter bdag rnal 'byor tshogs: chos brgyad blos bor dben par sgrub tshugs zungs: ḍā ki'i bka' bzhin bstan 'gro ris med skyongs: gangs gsum ljongs gsum 197)gnas gsum gsang phug tu: brag gi spre'u'i lo ru dus babs gnad: smon log ( Dakini Secret letter here) rkyen gyis ma bsgyur na: tshe yi gegs rkyen sel zhing bdun cur 'tsho: khwa ta rog po dmar ser tshos kyis bsgyur: rkyen des yul gnyis mi bde'i 'khrugs pa bgyid: cang shes 'dzin pa'i skyes bus ma dpyod na: nor bu'i 'od mdangs nyams pa'i grib kyis gos: mche ldan 'dzin ma sgyu ma'i bu mo des: dbang gzhu'i 'phrul gyis bdud rtsi dug tu 'gyur: lho rgyud nags khrod gnas pa'i gdong lnga pas: brtul zhugs ma nges dmar ser mdangs 'dzin pa'i: seng dkar khyu gcig smon lam dbang gis 'dzom: zab pa'i man ngag las ldan dpal du shar: dus tshigs dus kyi rten 'brel ma log cing: tshul bzhin gnad dang ldan par 'dzom gyur na: g.yu 'brug gtsug gi nor bu lon par nges: nyag la sngar med gser gyi me tog 'khrungs: 'bras bu'i bstan pa gyad kyi gtsug nor bzhin: mi mngon gab pa'i gnas su gyur pa yi: rkyen des srin mo spun gsum kha dar nas: yul gru gsum la khrag gi 198)mtsho mo 'khyil: pad 'byung sprul pa'i mthu yis ma 'dul na: tha ma bod khams phung ba'i chom rkun byed: nam mkha'i khri gdugs mun pa'i smag dang 'phrad:

se phung sprul pas rgyal bstan thabs kyis bshig: sa yi bcud nyams lo thog 'bras mi 'byung: dmag 'khrugs mu ge nad yams la sogs dang: sde 'khrugs nang dme'i 'thab rtsod rgyun mi chad: padma'i mtsho la gser gyi ngang khyu 'khor: gser mig 'dzin pa mi gtsang lam du byings: mdo gsum thang du nya mo bye tshan thon: 'od dkar zla ba'i bdud rtsi'i bsil chab kyis: mi srun srin mo phrin las dbal gyis gzhom: khye'u chung 'brog mi bai ro g.yu sgra dang: lang gro la sogs rje 'bangs sprul pa yis: thabs rnams du mas bod khams re zhig skyob: snyigs dus sems can gter dang ma 'phrad na: rang bzo'i chos kyis grol ba thob mi srid: de phyir padma'i brgyud 'dzin rjes 'jug rnams: 'chi ba dran na gter chos nyams su longs: 'khor bar mi gnas dben rir sgrub tshugs zungs: dkor nag log 'tsho'i zas spongs slong mor brten: chos brgyad 'khrul 199)pa'i las la mgo ma 'khor: blo sna rtse gcig gu ru pad 'byung dang: mchog gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror gtod: tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob bo skal ldan rnams: legs nyes gsal ba'i brda 'di khyed la gdams: yal bar ma dor tsitta'i klong du sbos: 'phrul gyi brdzu bag 'phrul bzhin ngoms pa'i tshe: khyod kyang yul 'dir sdod pa'i gnas dben kyang: sa ma ra thi'i rten 'brel gyis bskul nas: phyogs min phyogs su bgrod la ci cha yod: skal ldan chos brgyud 'dzin pa de ru 'dus: srin bya nag pos ngar skad ma sgrogs na: yul der re zhig gnas na 'gro don 'byung: gsang grogs ( Dakini Secret letter here) 'phrad gyur na: tshe yi bar chad re zhig sel bar nges: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes shing mo phag gi lo'i zla tshes la mkha' 'gro kun gsal dbang mo yin skad pas de ltar zer snang 'char yang snang cha la bden rdzun cha chod dka' bas btang snyoms su bzhag yod skabs mi mkho dgu mkho'i rnal 'byor pa rang gi nye gnas shākya'i dge btsun tshul khrims rdo rjes yang yang nan cher bskul ngor bde ba'i rdo rjes 'khrul snang yig ris su

200)bris pa'o// dge'o// ༈ dus 'dzin shing glang lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i gnam gang nyi phyed yol dus su yod skabs: dbyings thig le 'od dkar gsal ba'i klong: skyabs 'khor lo'i mgon po las 'brel rtsal: dpal he ru ka pa'i chas ldan pa: ma mkha' 'gro gnyis bcas dbyings snang shar: zhal 'dzum pa'i tshul gyis 'di skad gsungs: tshur gson dang brtse ldan snying gi grogs: lam zab mo lhun grub 'od gsal la: gol shor dang nor sa'i 'phrang med kyang: rtsa rlung thig rgyas btab gnad gsang la: thabs mkhas pas nyams len 'di ltar mdzod: mi gzhan la blo gros gsal mi dgos: nged thabs shes sngon gyi dam bcas bzhin: dus dus su nyams len gab 'khrugs rnams: ngas khyod la smra'o yid la zungs: rang rig mi 'gyur dbus mtha' bral: stong dbyings chos sku byang chub sems: 'gyu ba dngos med ye shes gsal: bde stong spros bral blo las 'das: zung 'jug rtogs pa mkha' ltar khyab: nyon mongs skyon bral ngang der grol: gang shar chos nyid 'khor lo ste: bsal bzhag mi dgos gdod nas dag: 'dir snang sgyu 201)ma'i dpe bcu bzhin: chags zhen 'khrul 'dzin gzhi la sangs: chos nyid don la som nyi bral: 'khrul snang 'khrul byed yul las 'das: gol shor nor ba'i 'dzin zhen bor: thams cad ro snyoms chos skur rtogs: sku gsum mnyam nyid ngang du klod: de ni khregs chod gsal 'debs yin: lus gnad gang bder shig ger zhog: rtsa gnad lus la gdab par mdzod: sgyu lus 'od skur grol ba'i gnad: ngag rlung ma bcos rang sar 'phen: rlung gnad ngag la gdab par mdzod: las rlung ye shes rlung du 'phos: sems nyid ma bcos ngang du skyongs: rig gnad sems la gdab par mdzod: sems nyid 'od gsal smin par byed: 'char ba yul gyi gnad gzer na: dbyings kyi ye shes lam du mngon: gzigs pa sgo yi gnad brtson na: dbyings snang thig le'i skabs 'byed byed: gzir ba rig pa'i gnad ldan na:

gang snang ye shes grogs su 'char: ngag rlung rang sor 'phen pa yis: dag dang ma dag rlung skabs 'byed: sems dang sems byung shugs su 'phen: snang sems rig par grol ba'i gnad: chos nyid 'od gsal dbyings su 'phen: 202) rig pa dbyings thig mi 'bral gnad: las rlung dbu mar bcing ba yis: rlung bcu las su rung ba'i gnad: sems rtog rig par bcings ba yis: snang sems chos skur grol ba'i gnad: dbyings dang ye shes thig le gsum: ci bzhin ma nor gnad la res: gang snang gnyis 'dzin blo bor la: chos nyid mi 'gyur dgongs pa skyongs: lhun grub 'od gsal ngang gis 'char: de sogs che long tsam yin pas: skabs skabs gsal 'debs nga yis smra: yang bdag gis smre sngags kyis mchi ma 'khrugs nas 'di skad zhus: dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med rig pa'i sku: rang rig don gyi bla ma he ru ka: snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon po las 'brel rtsal: thugs rje zhi ba'i dbyings su mi gzims par: mgon med nyam thag bdag la thugs rjes gzigs: sngon smon las 'brel bzang pos gter la dbang: yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i khyed dang 'phrad: myur lam gsang sngags spyod pa'i skal bar ldan: bogs 'byin brtan thob rlung sems dbu mar drangs: nang dbyings 'od gsal snang bzhi mtha' ru phyin: zung 'jug rig sku mngon gyur lam mchog brnyes: 'on kyang bsod nams dman dang bdud dbang gis: 203)rje khyed yul du mi bzhugs zhing du yibs: mgon med bdag ni gcig pur shul du bor: nyin mtshan bar med sems rtsa sdug gis naun: gsal byed dbang sgor chu rgyun bar med 'bebs: de 'dra'i sdug bsngal bsam tshe skyo ba skye: man ngag gdams khrid gnad gsang zhu sa med: gol shor nor gsum gegs sel su yis byed: kho mo'i las mtha' de ltar dgos pa yi: sngon las ngan pa'i rkyen dbang ci las byung: ye shes spyan ldan khyed kyis bstan du gsol:

da ni myur du 'bral med thugs rjes zungs: zhes dang: yang bdag gis nyid sku dbyings su bsdus nas nyin zhag bco lnga tsam song skabs yang sprul gyi dgongs pa gtad pa e yin bsam pa'i rtags mtshan re byung bas gsal po zhig gsung du gsol zhus pas: yang dpa' bo'i zhal nas bdag nam yang khyed dang 'du 'bral med pas: nga sprul byis pa chung ngus khyed la dgos pa e yod mi shes gsungs: yang bdag gis nyid kyi zhal bzhes ltar bsod sprul rin po che'i thugs rten du nyid 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes pa de'i don dang ldan pa bka' drin mi chung bar zhu zhus pas: yang 204)ḍā ki'i zhal nas 'di skad zer: he he: lho gser gyi ba dan 'od po che: byang mun pa'i khrod du sku bskyod na: lung chen gnyis 'dus pa'i g.yon zur na: ri khro bo 'gying 'dra'i g.yas zur na: khong sangs rgyas gling pa'i rnam rol gar: gter 'dzin pa shast+ra'i ming gis brgyan: chos zab pa'i rang skal dus su sprod: de'i gnad dang ldan par ma gyur na: 'dzum drug gis khur la ci cha yod: sku ye shes sgyu ma'i zlos gar ni: sngon tshe rabs las 'phro'i 'brel ba can: thog ma yi ming can mi mo la: sgyu 'phrul gyi zla zer nirmakaḥ g.yu 'brug gi zer dang ma 'phrad na: thabs mkhas na bstan pa'i nyi gzhon shar: blo rig pa dpyod shes mkhas gyur na: dus nam zhig mi 'gyang rang nor rnyed: da de dang de sogs rig pas dpyod: yul ldan pa'i skyes bu ma gtogs pa'i: khyod gang shar yul du mi 'doms par: sbas gsang dang ngag sgo bsdam pa gnad: ces zer nas thams cad dbyings snang thig le'i rol par mi snang bar gyur ro: ces pa 'di'ang 'khrul snang gab sbas su yod skabs gzhan tshig gi rjes su 'brangs nas lung bstan 'chal tshig tu shor 205)ba'i rkyen gyis skal ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa tshul khrims rdo rje dang tshogs rgyam gnyis kyis nan cher bskul ngor kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos 'khrul snang yig ris su bris pa dge'o//

༈ he he: nyams chung gi rgan mo'i bsam tshod la sbyar na: gter min gyi gter 'dra'i yig ris kyis ci byed: dus ngan gyi rang mtshang mi 'gyang bar ngoms dus: las ngan gyi sems can bdag 'dra yis mi thul: mdo sngags la mi gnas slob ngan re yod kyang: rang gzhan kun ngan song sa bon de red na: mtsho skyes kyi bla ma pad 'byung gi zhal nas: chos lam du zhugs kyang chos bred du song ba'i: skyon ldan gyi 'khor slob spang ba de gnad yin: rang gzhan kun dug chu'i 'dam rdzab la lhung nges: zhes gsungs kyi rdo rje'i tshig zhor la bltas na: yul de dang de yi phyogs su ni nye bas: sngon las dbang drag po'i stobs shugs zhig med tshe: rang gcig pur nges med gnas yul du 'gro snyam: gnas ka ling ka yi 'byung po des bskul nas: lho gser gyi ba dan ci 'gyur ni mi shes: grogs bi ma'i sprul pa 'phrul ldan zhig med na: 206)grangs lnga phrag dgu yol dbang gzhu bzhin: dbyings nam mkhar thim la ci cha yod: seng dkar mo'i g.yu ral 'brug gis lon: dpa' bo yos khur ( Dakini Secret letter here) de sogs 'byung 'gyur bya ba la: yid 'khums nas gang shar rdzun ris su: sprang su kha badzra ming gis bris: ༈ gnyid 'od gsal 'dres pa'i snang cha la: yul zhing khams phun tshogs rnam dag dbus: 'od lnga ldan gzi brjid 'khrigs pa'i klong: nga'i skyabs gcig 'dren ston chos kyi rje: pha padma las 'brel yud tsam mjal: legs nyes kyi brda don sna tshogs zhus: grangs mang bas yid ngor mi gsal kyang: bu shī la badzra 'dod don du: brda 'phrul gyi rol mo 'di skad gsungs: ya ya: tsandan sdong po'i rtse na: gsung snyan rma bya'i bsgyur mkhan: mkha' lding gzhon nu'i stobs kyis: rang nor cung zhig lon par: dri bsung ngad pa'i ro la: skal ldan bung ba'i tshogs 'du: gter gnyis bstan pa gsal ba: brag gis spre'us bsu na: sgra brgya'i gzi mdangs de tsam:

sngon smon las 'phro ldan pas: gter gnyis las gnyer dbang ba: pha yi bka' ltar 207)bsgrub dang: mi ring don gnyis 'byung nges: ngur smrig bstan la 'jug nas: ma bcos lcang lo ldan na: gnas skabs 'phral rkyen des sel: 'di 'og chu gsum 'dus pa: a yis brgyan pa'i yul du: khrims ldan dpa' bo'i ming can: dag snang chos skor 'byed pa'i: rten 'brel gnad zab legs 'ong: dam sri'i cho 'phrul ngoms pas: lo 'dir cung zhing 'tshe bas: sel byed kun 'dus 'jigs bzlog: 'byung bzhi gang la byas kyang: sa dpal gnad la brten dgos: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sgrub pa: 'phrul gyi cho ga zab dgos: gnad ldan tshul bzhin bsgrub na: 'phral rkyen de yis sel nges: g.yu 'brug dung gi rwa la: ha lo'i ku muta bzhad pas: blo ldan rig pas dpyod la: stabs ka gzab pa gal che: byang gi mi sdug bdag pos: tsandan dri bsung bcom pas: khrims kyi ba gam g.yo tshe: blo ngan kha ta rog pos: gzi mdangs rma byar 'gran 'ong: de dus nga yi zab sgrub: brtson 'grus lcag gis bskul nas: zab gsum gnad du bsnun 208)na: na ngan g.yul las rgyal nges: de dang de sogs spyod dang: 'phral 'phral brda don gsal 'ong: gzhan la gu hya a thaṃ:

ces pa 'di yang snying gi bu gcig shī la badzra gyi bzhed don du 'khrul 'byams mdo med su kha badzra gyis ser dgon dben khrod nas bris pa'o// ༈ dus 'dzin me stag lo'i zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin gling bu'i sgra tshor bas rkyen byas te bla ma yid bzhin nor bu shin tu dran nas ngu zhing bsdad yod pas: gter sgrom gyi steng nas bya ze mo lta bu'i gtsug sgro shin tu ring ba kha dog sna tshogs su bkra ba zhig byung nas 'di skad zer: ya ya a lcam bzhin legs la: khyed gcig pur sems gcong ci'i phyir dgos: nga bde bde mkha' 'gro'i grong khyer nas: mdangs lnga ldan thig ler brdzus te 'ongasaḥ khyed yid gcong mi dgos ngas grogs byed: gnas lnga yi mkha' 'gro dgyes skong phyir: bcud 'dzin gyi bu mo bcus nyer drangs: bzhin ldan gyi stobs rtsal yul ltar bgrod: so gnyis kyi zla ba'i 'od zer dang: bcu phrag bzhi ni nyi ma'i snying po gnyis: de brda dang brda lan rten 'brel bsgrigs: zung 209)'jug gi pho nya'i rtsal rdzogs te: mdangs gcig grogs gcig gis byed lags sam: de'i stobs kyis 'khrul snang gnas su dag: rnam smin gyi lus dwangs sku ru smin: sku gsum gyi 'bras bu gcig char rdzogs: don go'am sngags kyi rnal 'byor ma: zhes zer bas: bdag gis smras pa: snang ba bden med kyi 'khrul khang na: gzugs snang ma nges pa'i ri mo shar: 'phrul bya lnga ldan gyi 'od can khyed: gnas gang nas 'ong dang da gang 'gro: don ci'i phyir 'dir yongs bdag la smos: nga grogs po khyod kyis dgos pa med: don snang stong gnyis med kyi ye shes 'di: lhan skyes kyi pho nya bde chen mchog: des mi chog grogs pos ci zhig byed: nga 'dus byas chos la skyo ba skyes: pha bla mas bor nas lo gsum song: bshes med kyi dwa'u gcig pur lus: las gci la thug kyang skyabs mgon med:

mdze nad kyis thebs pa'i skyes bu bzhin: 'khor slob mas bskyur nas lo gsum yin: sems sdug gis myos kyang re sa med: nag can gyi mi bzhin sa mthar phud: pha'i gdan sar ma thon lo gsum song: dam ldan 210)pa'i mched grogs dang ma 'phrad: skyid sdug gi rnam grangs bshad sa med: sems sdug gi zin nas lo gsum song: skyo rog gi grogs po mi bsam do: snying rlung gis zin nas lo gsum song: 'dir snang la 'dug na mi snyam gyi: mi gral nas phud nas lo gsum yin: gzhan don zhig e 'grub mi bsam gi: sems 'khri shing gi bu yis bskyur nas song: da brgyud 'dzin zhig byung na mi snyam gi: rgyab pha ming med pa'i skyon dbang gis: mi kun gyis dor nas lo gsum yin: da chos brgyad zhig e 'grub mi bsam gi: las ji ltar byas kyang sdug bsngal rgyu: da bsam zhing bsam na skyo ba 'phel: yul gang du bsdad kyang bla ma brten: chos gdams ngag gsal tshe bla ma dran: shar rta bdun dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i tshe: pha bla ma'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dran: 'od zer gyis mun khang sangs pa'i dus: pha bla ma'i gsang gsum yon tan dran: nyi 'od kyis 'gro ba'i bde skyid byed: pha bla ma'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis: gdams ngag gi byin rlabs bstsal ba dran: de dgung mo nub rir phyogs pa'i dus: pha bdag gi mgon du byon pa 'di: slar mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa dran: da de sogs las dang bya byed kun: pha bla ma dran pa'i gsos su gyur: nga gcig pur sems gcong de yis byed: khyod 'phrul bya shes rab blo ldan pa: sems bag phobs bdag gi ngag gsal nyon: pha 211)padma las 'brel chos sku dang: nga chos nyid bde skyong dbang mo gnyis: don bde stong mchog tu mi 'gyur klong: dbyings ye shes 'du 'bral med mod kyang: gang 'dul gyi gdul bya'i 'gro ba'i ngor: thugs rje yi phrin las shar ba'i tshe: dus nam yang 'bral med smon lam btab:

de de bzhin 'grub pa'i dpang po ru: khyed ye shes lha yis mdzad du gsol: thabs shes rab 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel gyis: zab gter gyi bstan pas sa steng khyab: lus can gyi 'gro ba ma lus pa: mi gnas kyi gtan srid myur zin nas: gnas zangs mdog dpal rir skye bar shog: don go'am 'phrul ldan lha yi bya: ces smras pas: kho na re: ting ting go: ting ting go: pa ra mi ta tsitta mant+ra: a nu rwa ga ya mi ho st+waṃ: he sa ya na sa ma ra sa: bidyā ra dza a na ya hoḥ de don khrol naḥ gab sbas tshig yin: nub kyi rgya stag: rten 'brel ri mo: a darsha yi: gzugs la ngoms dus: tshe chos gdul bya: lhag ma skyongs dang: ma nges dus bzhi'i: rtags tshad rdzogs dus: dpal ri'i zhing du: las 'brel 212)rtsal gyis: bsu ba brtsams nas: ma dang mkha' 'gros: ye shes dar lam: 'phrul ldan nga yis: sna la drangs yong: da dung yid la: bcags pa'i yul der: yun ring sdod grabs: ma byed i go: byang gi dug sbrul: lce gnyis ngoms dus: brda don gsal yong: ka li'i 'phrul gyi: go cha ma zhan: 'phral 'phral legs nyes: de yis sel nges: brag gi spre'us: sgyu rtsal ngoms dus: byang phyogs mun pa'i: khrod du ma bzhugs: gyi na'i tshul gyis: ma nges nges pa'i: gnas gsum 'grims na: bzhi bcur 'phen srid: akṣa shrīs: smon lam bsdus na: a nanta yis: zlos gar rol nas: bstan 'gro'i bde skyid: nub nas shar nges: lho nas chas pa'i: yal ga'i ri dwags : rma bya'i 'phrul gyi: rang mdangs ngoms na: rang nor ma phog: mi ring rnyed 'ong: smon lam las kyi: 'brel zab yod pa'i: rigs ldan 'byung tshe: btang snyoms ma mdzad: tshe chos gdul bya: de la rag las: phan tshun thabs mkhas: shes rab ma zhan: 'jig rten mi yi: ngo srung bor la: brtul zhugs spyod pas: bstan 'gro'i don mdzod: de dang de 213) sogs: stabs ldan med tshe: sgyu ma'i bu mos: sgyu 'phrul bshig nas: sgyu rtsal ldan pas:

dbyings la bzhud do: gab sbas tshig 'di: tsittar gu hya: rig pas dpyod la: rten dang 'brel 'byung: gzhan rkyen sabta'i: dbang du ma gtong: gter gnyis bstan pa: khyod la dbang bas: legs nyes gang byung: thad kar chod la: pha gcig bla ma: thugs kyis ma gtong ཿ dus kun brtse bas: brda byang gsal 'ong: ma nges dpal ri: padma 'od du: thabs shes dbyer med: lhan du 'tshogs nges: de sogs rig pas: dpyod shes mdzod dang: dus dus nga yis: brda gsal ngoms yong: nga 'gro bde bde: mkha' 'gro'i gling la: shugs ldan rtsal gyis: gnam 'phang bcad nas: dbyings kyi sprul pa: dbyings la bzhud do: ces zer ba dang mnyam du: 'od dkar dmar gnyis su gyur nas bdag gi dran 'dus kyi 'khor lor thim mo: sa ma ya: gtam 'di tsho dgos med nges pa'i tshig: gnas tsittar rgya yis btab yod kyang ཿ khong shī la badzra thugs glen pas: bskul lcag gis 'dug 214)tu ma ster nas: bzhed skong du brdzun tshig yi ger bris: da rang gzhan le lo'i rgyu yin phyir: thabs gang drag byas nas rang kha bzung: nga dgongs pa mi 'gyur gab sgrom la: chos sna tshogs snang ba'i ri mo shar: mjug rdzogs pa'i dus med ngal ba'i rgyu: skul lcag gis rjogs thabs byed pa dben: don go'am shī la badzra lags: de ltar dgos med gtam 'dis thun bcag gi rgyu byed// bri bar mi 'dod tsitta'i gwa'u ru sba snyam// zur tsam shī la badzra thugs bzhed de skong phyir// dug lnga 'chol nyog spyod pa mdo med kyi sprang mo// 'khrul zhig kun bzang bde skyong chos nyid kyi dbang mos// sug rtse rlung la bskyon nas shog dkar gyi ngos la// ser dgon dben ri'i g.yas zur mkha' 'gro yi 'du ra// bkra shis dga' ba'i tshal nas yig ris su bgyis so// dge'o//
